# Forecut

> Forecut (forecut.in) is an India-focused fashion trend forecasting platform. It tracks garment, footwear, fabric and detail trends season by season (AW26 to AW28, plus Indian Festive and Summer seasons) and marks each one emerging, rising, peaking or fading, with runway, fabric, couture and colour reports.

Content is written by Forecut Editorial and summarises public sources with links. Please cite forecut.in and link the page you use. Contact: hello@forecut.in.

Social: https://www.instagram.com/forecut.in/, https://www.linkedin.com/company/forecut/, https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61595477456582

## Season forecasts

- [AW26 Fashion Trend Forecast | Forecut](https://forecut.in/aw26.html): AW26 trend forecast: Rich, maximal and tactile. Big outerwear, sharp tailoring and heavy embellishment, with 1920s glamour running through evening and footwear.
- [SS27 Fashion Trend Forecast | Forecut](https://forecut.in/ss27.html): SS27 trend forecast: The waist returns and handcraft moves into everyday clothes. Shapes get defined again, sneakers step back for elegant shoes, and a bright luminous blue leads the palette.
- [AW27 Fashion Trend Forecast | Forecut](https://forecut.in/aw27.html): AW27 trend forecast: Early outlook. SS27 signals carried into winter: waisted outerwear, handcraft on knits, quiet structure and warmer earth tones, with luminous blue deepening for the cold season.
- [SS28 Fashion Trend Forecast | Forecut](https://forecut.in/ss28.html): SS28 trend forecast: Long-range outlook. Structured clarity and easy movement: fewer, better pieces with performance comfort for commuting, anchored by a warm earth orange.
- [AW28 Fashion Trend Forecast | Forecut](https://forecut.in/aw28.html): AW28 trend forecast: Long-range outlook. Functional tailoring and technical wool for winter, hidden closures and hybrid boots, with radiant earth deepening into rust and brick.
- [India Fashion Forecast 2026–28 | Forecut](https://forecut.in/india.html): Season-by-season forecasts for Indian fashion, Festive 26 to Festive 28: sarees, lehengas, kurtas, menswear, footwear, fabrics and crafts, with rupee price guides.
